about: Product files over 800 lines and the size each had when M7-S00 was made (main ffadc235). One entry per line, sorted by path, so a split card edits only its own line: it lowers the number, and the last card of a file removes the entry. A file not listed here may not pass 800 lines. desktop/src/main/main.ts is frozen on purpose (not split, user 2026-11-16): its number stays. Checked by desktop/scripts/check-lines.mjs.
